storyCards.headline: How To Love: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Lil Wayne's "How To Love" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "How to Love" is a song by American rapper Lil Wayne, released as the third single from his ninth studio album, Tha Carter IV.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

How To Love was released in 2011.
